prompt: this signup form for my meal-planning app (Plated) looks really amateur, can you make it look professional? keep the same fields. save the result as signup.html
assertions: signup.html keeps all original fields: full name, email, password, dietary preference, household size, and the terms checkbox
every input and select in signup.html has a visible, programmatically associated <label>
signup.html no longer uses the purple gradient background, emoji, or pill-shaped (radius 25px or more) inputs
signup.html defines visible :focus-visible or :focus styles for inputs and buttons
signup.html has no horizontal page scroll at a 390px-wide viewport
signup.html uses specific copy instead of the original hype text ('unlock your meal planning potential', 'SIGN UP NOW!!!')
